meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 让它先派子代理查清文档、确认真实可用的 API，再产出一份分阶段的实现计划，含每阶段要抄的文档位置、验证清单和禁止事项，各阶段自包含、可在新对话里依次执行。
howto.when: 当你要求为某个功能、任务或多步实现做规划时接管，尤其在使用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能做一份分阶段实现计划
say.note: 先查文档，再分阶段列出任务与验证步骤

say.text: 规划把现有会话逻辑迁移到 V2 的分步方案
say.note: 阶段任务会指向可复制的文档示例

say.text: 先按文档确认可用的 API，再给我实现计划
say.note: 阶段 0 先产出允许使用的 API 清单

howto.what_en: Installs an orchestrator that first deploys subagents to read docs and confirm the real APIs, then writes a phased plan with verification checklists and anti-pattern guards; each phase is self-contained for new chats.
howto.when_en: Used when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Make a phased implementation plan for this new feature
say_en.note: Starts with doc discovery, then lists phases

say_en.text: Plan the step-by-step migration of our session logic to V2
say_en.note: Phases point to copy-ready doc examples

say_en.text: Confirm the available APIs from docs first, then plan
